info.title: ThemeAudit
info.description:
Command-line face of Bennewitz.Ninja.XamlQuality: audits an Avalonia, WPF or MAUI theme
      for the resource keys it leaves undefined — the invisible-control cases — and for tokens
      that fall below a contrast floor, and generates the compat dictionaries that close them.

      Themes in, consumers in, findings out. All analysis lives in the
      Bennewitz.Ninja.XamlQuality library; this project is argument parsing and reporting, so
      the same rules are equally available from a test project without shelling out.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: theme-audit — finds the resource keys an Avalonia theme leaves undefined and the tokens below a contrast floor.

commands.name: inventory
commands.description: List the resource keys (x:Key) defined under a directory, per file and in total.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Directory containing .axaml/.xaml files (a theme checkout, or a project's templates).

commands.name: compat
commands.description: Generate the configured compat dictionaries: the keys one theme defines that another lacks, mapped onto the latter's tokens.

options.name: --config
options.description: The audit configuration (themes, consumers, compat). [default: theme-audit.json]

options.name: --check
options.description: Compare each committed output with a fresh run instead of writing it; exit 1 when one is stale or missing, with a stale one's fresh output written beside it as name.received.ext (the drift check). [default: False]
